originalTitle: Among Us: New Influencer Role Trailer 📸 Out Now!
content: Update v19.0.0 is out now with our newest Ghost Crewmate role - the Influencer. With the Message ability, send images to living Crewmates to help them catch the Impostor(s)... but choose wisely! Your fellow Crewmates might misunderstand what you're trying to say. Read more about the role here: https://www.innersloth.com/new-ghost-crewmate-role-the-influencer-emergency-meeting-44/ Among Us is a game of teamwork and betrayal for 4-15 players...in space! Play online or via local WiFi as you attempt to prepare your spaceship for departure, but beware as one or more random players among the Crew are Impostors bent on killing everyone.
